name: multi-step-loader
title: Multi Step Loader
description: A full-screen loading overlay that lists the stages of a task and advances through them. Finished stages get filled check marks, the current one turns green, and later ones wait greyed out.
use: A multi-second setup or fetch needs to show which stages are done and which one is running.
avoid: The overlay is fixed and blocks the page, and with looping on it never settles on its own.
a11y: Step changes are shown by colour alone, the overlay traps no focus, and nothing handles Escape to close it. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-screen dark overlay washes the page into blur and holds a centered vertical list of short steps. Each row opens with a circular check icon; the running step is lime green and the finished rows above it show solid white checks.
behaves: Starting the loader fades the overlay in and moves the highlight one stage down every set interval. Passed stages lock to white filled checks, the current line glows green, and stages ahead stay faint until reached.
customise: Pass loadingStates as an array of text strings, set duration in milliseconds, and choose loop or a single pass. Colours, blur and the fade mask are written into the file.
weight: light: Six animated rows, one timeout and a blur layer; it sits idle while closed.
